name: Omni Studio · Approval RPA email (configure SMTP before activation)

parameters.query:
WITH reminders AS (
    INSERT INTO studio_automation_messages(plan_id,plan_version,recipient_user_id,recipient_email,kind)
    SELECT p.id,p.version,u.id,u.email,reminder.kind
    FROM publishing_plans p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        ('approval_due_soon',(p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz<=now()+interval '3 hours' AND p.updated_at<=now()-interval '1 hour'),
        ('approval_overdue',p.updated_at<=now()-interval '2 days')
    ) AS reminder(kind,due)
    JOIN studio_users u ON u.workspace_id=1 AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager')
      AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
    WHERE p.status='pending' AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
      AND reminder.due
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
), stale AS (
    UPDATE studio_automation_messages m SET status='cancelled'
    WHERE m.status='queued' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publishing_plans p JOIN studio_users u ON u.id=m.recipient_user_id
        WHERE p.id=m.plan_id AND p.version=m.plan_version AND p.status='pending'
          AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
          AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email=m.recipient_email
          AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
    ) RETURNING m.id
), jobs AS (
    INSERT INTO studio_rpa_runs(kind,status,plan_id,plan_version)
    SELECT DISTINCT 'approval_read','queued',p.id,p.version
    FROM studio_automation_messages m JOIN publishing_plans p
      ON p.id=m.plan_id AND p.version=m.plan_version
    JOIN studio_users u ON u.id=m.recipient_user_id
    WHERE m.status='queued' AND p.status='pending'
      AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
      AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email=m.recipient_email
      AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
) SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jobs) AS jobs_queued,
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM stale) AS stale_cancelled

WITH claimed AS (
    UPDATE studio_automation_messages m SET status='sending',claimed_at=now()
    WHERE m.id IN (
        SELECT q.id FROM studio_automation_messages q
        JOIN publishing_plans p ON p.id=q.plan_id AND p.version=q.plan_version
        JOIN studio_users u ON u.id=q.recipient_user_id
        JOIN studio_rpa_runs r ON r.plan_id=p.id AND r.plan_version=p.version
          AND r.kind='approval_read' AND r.status='success'
        WHERE q.status='queued' AND p.status='pending'
          AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
          AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email=q.recipient_email
          AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
          AND r.result->>'planId'=p.id::text
          AND (r.result->>'planVersion')::integer=p.version
        ORDER BY q.created_at FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 20
    ) RETURNING m.id
) SELECT id FROM claimed

WITH invalid AS (
    UPDATE studio_automation_messages m SET status='cancelled'
    WHERE m.id='{{ $('Claim ready notifications').item.json.id }}'::uuid
      AND m.status='sending'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publishing_plans p JOIN studio_users u ON u.id=m.recipient_user_id
        JOIN studio_rpa_runs r ON r.plan_id=p.id AND r.plan_version=p.version
          AND r.kind='approval_read' AND r.status='success'
        WHERE p.id=m.plan_id AND p.version=m.plan_version AND p.status='pending'
          AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
          AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email=m.recipient_email
          AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
          AND r.result->>'planId'=p.id::text
          AND (r.result->>'planVersion')::integer=p.version
      ) RETURNING m.id
) SELECT m.id,m.kind,m.recipient_email,r.result->>'name' AS name,
         r.result->>'creator' AS creator,r.result->>'content' AS content,
         r.result->>'pages' AS pages,r.result->>'scheduledAt' AS scheduled_at,
         r.read_at,m.plan_id,m.plan_version
  FROM studio_automation_messages m
  JOIN publishing_plans p ON p.id=m.plan_id AND p.version=m.plan_version
  JOIN studio_users u ON u.id=m.recipient_user_id
  JOIN studio_rpa_runs r ON r.plan_id=p.id AND r.plan_version=p.version
    AND r.kind='approval_read' AND r.status='success'
 WHERE m.id='{{ $('Claim ready notifications').item.json.id }}'::uuid
   AND m.status='sending' AND p.status='pending'
   AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now()
   AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email=m.recipient_email
   AND u.email !~* '\.test$'
   AND r.result->>'planId'=p.id::text
   AND (r.result->>'planVersion')::integer=p.version
